title: Verify fstab syntax and options
summary: Check /etc/fstab for syntax errors or invalid mount options before rebooting. This prevents boot failures caused by typos in the configuration file.

steps.explain: Run findmnt with the verify flag to check for syntax errors and invalid options in /etc/fstab.
steps.expect: Output listing any errors or warnings found in the fstab file. If no errors are found, it may output nothing or a success message depending on the version.
